title: Fake Compliance Training
scenario: A training email threatens suspension unless staff log in today.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.C: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.
answers.D: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.

explanation: Fake Compliance Training: the trap is to make speed feel safer than verification. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Training should be accessed through the known LMS.
